class A:
 def use(self): return 7
a=A()
print(a.use==a.use,hash(a.use)==hash(a.use))

class A:
 __hash__=None
 def use(self): return 7
a=A()
print(hash(a.use)==hash(a.use))

class A:
 def __hash__(self): return 1
 def __eq__(self,other): raise ValueError("wrong")
 def use(self): return 7
a=A()
b=A()
print(a.use==b.use,a.use==a.use)

class A:
 def use(self): return 7
a=A()
d={a.use:[7]}
print(d[a.use][0],a.use in d,len(d))
d[a.use]=[8]
print(d[a.use][0],len(d))
del d[a.use]
print(len(d))

class A:
 def use(self): pass
 other=use
a=A()
print(a.use==a.other,hash(a.use)==hash(a.other),{a.use:7}[a.other])

class A:
 def use(self): pass
a=A()
print(hash((a.use,))==hash((a.use,)),{(a.use,):7}[(a.use,)])

a=[]
print(a.append==a.append,hash(a.append)==hash(a.append),{a.append:7}[a.append])

a=[]
b=[]
print(a.append==b.append,len({a.append:7,b.append:8}))

def values(): yield 7
g=values()
print(g.send==g.send,hash(g.send)==hash(g.send),{g.send:7}[g.send],g.send==g.close)

f=type.__instancecheck__
print(hash(f)==hash(type.__instancecheck__),{f:7}[type.__instancecheck__])

class A: pass
f=A.__instancecheck__
print(f==A.__instancecheck__,hash(f)==hash(A.__instancecheck__),{f:7}[A.__instancecheck__])
print(hash(slice(1,7,2))==hash(slice(1,7,2)),hash(slice(None))==hash(slice(None)))
print(slice(True,7.0,2)==slice(1,7,2),hash(slice(True,7.0,2))==hash(slice(1,7,2)))

d={slice(1,7,2):[8]}
print(d[slice(1,7,2)][0],slice(1,7,2) in d)
d[slice(1,7,2)]=[9]
print(len(d),d[slice(1,7,2)][0])
del d[slice(1,7,2)]
print(len(d))

class A:
 def __hash__(self): return 7
 def __eq__(self,other): return True
x=(slice((A(),)),slice(A(),7))
y=(slice((A(),)),slice(A(),7))
print(x==y,hash(x)==hash(y),{x:8}[y])

class A:
 def __hash__(self): return 7
 def __eq__(self,other): return True
print({slice(A()):8}[slice(A())])

class A:
 def __hash__(self):
  print("hash")
  return 7
s=slice(A())
hash(s)
hash(s)
hash(slice([],1,2))
hash(slice(1,[],2))
hash(slice(1,2,[]))

class A:
 def __hash__(self): return 7
 def __eq__(self,other): return True
print(hash((A(),))==hash((A(),)),{(A(),):8}[(A(),)])
hash(slice(1),2)

class A:
 def use(self): pass
a=A()
x=slice((a.use,))
print(hash(x)==hash(slice((a.use,))),{x:7}[slice((a.use,))])
